record.where: v3.18 — THE SHAPES OF WORK (the same walk, different questions)

clauses.text: announced with NEW SHAPES OF WORK, explained in a mail
A ★★ station with three known neighbours posts a 2-3 leg chain through the towns that want what it makes, nearest-neighbour ordered

figure.note: the posted chain has two or three legs

clauses.text: each is a distinct card with its own tag on the board
a middle door takes its crates with the full hand-over ceremony, fills the town's stock, toasts LEG n/N — ONWARD and hands you no slip — the ledger waits

figure.note: the last door's result carries paymul 1.35, and the slip's row reads ×1.35

clauses.text: The last door grades the whole contract: par over the summed chain, condition averaged across every door
the slip's route line names every door
Abandoning a circuit turns each remaining leg's crates into lost cargo bound for its own door
A junior walker of the Order (generated, named, skills capped at 2 — that is the point) needs the road walked to a connected town the pathfinder can actually find

figure.note: the junior's highest skill is at most 2

clauses.text: drift past 220 units and they stop and call out

figure.note: the Walker is set 420 off, past the line, and the junior waits and calls out; the line at 220 itself is not sampled

clauses.text: Scrappers inside camp ground go for their crates first (the softer mark): a catch knocks a gold crate loose that you recover off the ground and hand back at their side
A wraith within 260 of them in mist freezes them mid-stride

figure.note: the wraith is set about 161 off, inside the radius; the radius's edge is not sampled
the Walker stands 40 off and the junior is freed; the reach's edge is not sampled

clauses.text: the Guide arbitrates: a frozen or left-behind convoy outranks the arrow's usual habits
Arrival counts only when you BOTH stand at the gate
+10 appreciation to the town that asked

figure.note: the asking town's appreciation rises by exactly 10

clauses.text: the walker joins the destination's fire pool, hireable, already road-trained (+26 Footwork)

figure.note: the walker's Footwork training is at least 26, or already a level

clauses.text: A town short of something (worst stock under 70) posts its top shortage by name

figure.note: a town at 22 seeds posts the wreck run, a town with every stock at 90 posts none; the line at 70 itself is not sampled
the site's distance from the town lies in 900..1400

clauses.text: where mistBase exceeds 0.5, drawn while the run holds it, labeled THE WRECK
Walk out empty (the Guide aims at the site)

figure.note: the result's paymul is 1.6 and the slip's row reads ×1.6

clauses.text: on top of the shortage multiplier, and condition grades against what the wreck gave, not the factory: bring them back no worse and the stars are full
a circuit at door 2, a convoy at 2/3 crates

design.what: the fairness pass deleted the stop: a junior left behind past the line calls out and trudges on at half pace, stride by stride, never frozen and never warped to your back
past 220 the junior still calls out, but no longer stops — they trudge on at half pace (DESIGN.md, the fairness pass §4)

unplaced.why: the record's 19 counted zero page errors among them; the rebuild proves it in the harness's own check and makes 19 of its own, and nothing records which two of the record's items the original proved in one check
